summary: A module manifest key was accepted as the publisher
details: A signatures table carried its own public key, so a self-signed module passed the gate that refuses an unsigned one. The fix does not treat that embedded key as a trust anchor. origin/main commit 277cf3b8c6638df974e9566e1adf49588199b1ba. Local stability/beta-gate has it as 0edb2c967f03e147096091fed936492e246bc506. The regression embedded_signature_key_is_not_a_trust_anchor passed on that commit. No release tag contains the fix. Reporter credit is blank pending consent. The report date was not separate from the fix commit.
